content:
Incident Bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: org=cygnus reporting sustained 5xx rate and high tail latency on inference endpoints. spike detected at 2026-03-15T11:02Z. paging oncall-sre.
Maya Patel: acked, pulling graphs. seeing QPS jump from 300 -> 3,200 over 7m, error rate ~12% and p99 latency > 6s.
Dan Rodriguez: oncall here. any customer-facing degradation? Maya, can you check frontend error codes?
Maya Patel: majority are 429 and 503 from our rate-limiter + backend queuing. stack traces show kv-cache eviction contended paths.
Leo Kim: pinging infra: looks like Cygnus is a high-commit tier but multiplexed on shared pool. Their requests are very bursty right now (large batch inference jobs per their logs).
Jen O'Neill: tagging acct team: @Ari (Acct) — Cygnus billing tier / contract? Do we have permission to temp-adjust limits?
Ari (Acct): They're on standard enterprise but haven't signed a rate override. We can approve a 2h emergency exception with engineering sign-off.
Dan Rodriguez: Plan: (1) Mitigate customer impact ASAP by increasing org rate limit and burst allowance for cygnus for 2 hours. (2) If that doesn't stabilize errors, apply feature-shape: disable heavy streaming endpoints for them or route to fallback model. (3) Postmortem + billing follow-up. 
Maya Patel: I'll prepare the change. Command to apply override: ```bash
curl -X POST https://internal-console/api/orgs/cygnus/ratelimit/override \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"rate_per_min":4200, "burst":8000, "expires_at":"2026-03-15T13:15:00Z", "reason":"emergency traffic spike - approved by acct"}'
```
Dan Rodriguez: Maya, go ahead once Leo and I ack. I'll be watching metrics and ready to rollback.
Leo Kim: ack. I pushed a quick autoscaling bump to the dedicated pool assigned to shared-hosted lane for 10% capacity — should help backend queueing.
Maya Patel: running override now... 
Maya Patel: response: 200 OK, override id=ovr_9c7b, applied.
Incident Bot: Change applied by maya - ratelimit override ovr_9c7b.
Dan Rodriguez: watching errors... p50 down to 180ms, p99 improving but still 1.2s. 5xx dropping to 2.3% from 12%. Good sign.
Leo Kim: heap contention still shows on a subset of inference hosts. I'll cordon and restart one noisy node after confirming lower traffic due to override. ETA 2m.
Maya Patel: contacted Cygnus support alias: "Cygnus SRE" with short note: we applied a temporary override to reduce customer errors; we'll follow up.
Ari (Acct): confirming Cygnus acknowledged and appreciates the temporary lift. They say they triggered large backfill jobs accidentally.
Dan Rodriguez: OK. Keep override for 2 hours as planned, we'll evaluate at +45m. If metrics continue to look good, schedule a graceful scale + quota review.
Jen O'Neill: creating incident ticket INC-20260315-89 for follow-up: include timeline, override id, impact window, and action items.
Maya Patel: adding debug log snippet captured during spike: ```
[2026-03-15T11:01:56Z] org=cygnus request_id=abcd1234 rate_limit_block=true queue_depth=245 svc_latency=6200ms
[2026-03-15T11:02:12Z] org=cygnus request_id=efgh5678 kv_cache_eviction=true host=inf-45
```
Dan Rodriguez: Good capture. After +30m, we'll run a targeted canary of disabling streaming for cygnus if p99 remains > 2s. But currently no need.
Leo Kim: restarted noisy node, telemetry looks cleaner. CPU pressure down and p99 decreased to 900ms.
Maya Patel: +15m from override: error rate 0.7%, tail latency p99 820ms. I'll note the change event in the console audit.
Incident Bot: Reminder scheduled: re-evaluate override ovr_9c7b at 2026-03-15T12:45:00Z.
Dan Rodriguez: closing active mitigation for now — status: stabilizing. Leave override in place until scheduled review. Assign follow-ups: Maya to export logs and attach to INC-20260315-89, Leo to run host-level post-checks, Jen/Ari to confirm billing/contract path forward with Cygnus.
Maya Patel: will add notes + timeline. also recommend we suggest Cygnus enable rate-limiter-friendly batching on their side; sharing best-practices doc.
Ari (Acct): will coordinate account meeting and escalate to CSM.
Jen O'Neill: nice work team. Marking thread resolved but keeping channel open for re-escalation. :thumbsup:
Dan Rodriguez: thanks all. we should include a short blameless postmortem and propose a guardrail: automatic small temporary overrides with manual approve for enterprise accounts to avoid reactive paging.
Maya Patel: noted, will draft proposal.
Incident Bot: Thread marked stable."
